# Card Info

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` (named export `CardInfoField`). The compound identity field every CardDef carries as `cardInfo`: name, summary, notes, thumbnail, plus theme selection. Hand-authored instance JSON should always include it in full.

## Usage
```ts
import { CardInfoField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/card-api';
```

The contained example shows the serialized shape.
